# Air Arabia

> > Official newsroom for Air Arabia (PJSC), the Middle East and North Africa's first and largest low-cost carrier, providing press releases, financial results, and route expansion announcements.

Air Arabia operates from its hub in Sharjah, UAE, serving destinations across Europe, Asia, and the Middle East. The newsroom features corporate communications including shareholder dividends, new route launches to destinations like Rome, Milan, and Warsaw, and quarterly financial performance updates.
